SaveScummer

Create checkpoints in games that don't offer them.

Retry a tough moment, learn faster, and spend less time replaying what you already know, so you can get back to the stories, builds, and choices you care about.

Download on GitHub

Supported games

We chose games where progress is costly to lose: permadeath ends rare builds, Ironman overwrites long campaigns, and autosaves lock in story choices. Each card explains where a checkpoint helps, including cases where a live run cannot yet be restored from save files.
